warnings.message: the border is opaque and one colour (#646664): probably art cut out on a background; export it with transparency, or key the background out with key = "#646664" in the .gmeta

Camera: the first orthographic camera takes orthoSize from the WorldView resource, so the camera's own value is ignored: set it in the scene's resources.WorldView (or from a system with fitWorldView) and remove it from the Camera

Camera: the flat 2D camera is drawn at WorldView.center, so its LocalTransform.position x and y are ignored: set the scene's resources.WorldView.center (or follow with WorldViewFollow) and leave x and y at 0
